Ana: Quick heads-up: we plan to publish the Optimize benchmarks blog Mon 09:00 UTC. Embargo until then. Draft link: https://go.redwood/opt-bench-2026.
Sam: Copy. I'll batch embargo emails at 08:30 UTC and a follow-up at 08:55 for EU reporters. Press list updated in the doc.
Noah: I'll cover live-monitoring and be available for quick tech quotes. Ops changed the autoscale window to include T-10m to T+30m. Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/publish-surge.
Design: Final hero image uploaded to the assets folder; social square and banner ready. Posting schedule prepared.
Ana: Legal confirm paragraph: partner mentions cleared but do not include PartnerZ raw numbers. Use the partner summary line.
Legal: Confirmed. Also flag: no raw internal perf tables in syndicated copies.
press-bot: Reminder: embargo_email_sender scheduled for 08:30 UTC.
Sam: Checklist: 1) embargo emails queued 2) hero image present 3) CDN purge T+00:05 4) social scheduled 5) runbook bookmarked. React when done.
Noah: :thumbsup: monitoring ready
Design: :thumbsup: images set
Sam: :thumbsup: embargo queued
Ana: I'll do a dry run at 08:50 UTC of the publish command. Manual publish snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/publish -H "Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN" -d '{"slug":"optimize-bench-2026"}'
```
Ana: If anything blocks, post in #release-control and escalate to Ops. See you on final sync at 08:55 UTC.
